name: Epic Dev
description: Serial sprint loop: read status, pick story, implement, review, with human gates on blocked and needs-review outcomes.
goal: Implement sprint stories iteratively until the epic is complete

runAgentConfig.prompt: Read the sprint document at {{var:sprint_doc}} and summarize the current sprint status. List completed stories, in-progress work, and remaining backlog items. Project context: {{var:project_context}}

nodes.name: Approval Blocked
nodes.prompt: The sprint is blocked. Review the blocker and decide whether to resume implementation or end the epic.

nodes.name: Approval Story Review
nodes.prompt: Review the completed story implementation before continuing the sprint loop.

runAgentConfig.prompt: Generate a final epic completion report summarizing all work done during this sprint run. Include completed stories, any blocked items, and outstanding issues. Sprint doc: {{var:sprint_doc}}
